description: The pie chart titled "Token Routing Distribution (FedHLM)" illustrates the distribution of token routing in a federated learning system. The chart is divided into three slices, representing different routing methods. The largest slice, occupying 94.5% of the chart, is labeled "LOCAL" and is colored green. The second slice, colored red, represents "EDGE_P2P" and accounts for 3.9% of the chart. The smallest slice, colored blue, represents "LLM" and makes up 1.6% of the chart. The chart does not include a legend, and the percentages are labeled directly on the corresponding slices. The slices are not visually emphasized in any particular way, and the chart does not indicate any specific order of the slices.
